title: How to fingerprint content with a hash
problem: I need a stable id for a piece of content so I can skip work I already did or ask the other side whether it already has this exact thing, and the browser and the server keep computing that id two different ways.
outcome: One call producing the same hex digest for the same content in either runtime, used as a cache key that needs no filename or version, with incoming ids rejected before they are trusted as keys.

knowledge: A Node.js or browser project that can run async code
